title: Concept: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy explicitly set to unsafe-none
description: The response explicitly opts out of cross-origin opener isolation. unsafe-none is the default in browsers that predate COOP, so setting it is equivalent to stating that cross-origin window references are wanted; it also defeats the isolation needed for cross-origin isolation features. A copied header template with the wrong value is the usual cause.
applicability: HTML responses that deliver a Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy header.
risk: Cross-origin window reference exposure; LOW severity.
